parts.text: 5 This question is about rate of reaction and equilibrium. A student investigates the rate of decomposition of aqueous hydrogen peroxide, H 2 O 2 , using manganese( IV ) oxide as a catalyst. The equation for the reaction is shown. 2H 2 O 2 (aq) → 2H 2 O(l) + O 2 (g) The student uses the apparatus shown in Fig. 5.1. Fig. 5.1 The student: ● adds the catalyst to the aqueous hydrogen peroxide ● replaces the container on the balance ● starts a stop-watch ● records the mass at regular time intervals.
